description: Figure 5(a) is a line plot illustrating the training loss as a function of training steps for several model configurations. The x-axis, labeled “#Iteration,” is linear and spans from 0 to 140,000, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled “Loss,” is linear and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Five distinct lines are plotted: “Vanilla” (purple, solid line) starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to about 2.6; “StrmLLM (n=64)” (blue, solid line) begins near 3.2 and declines to roughly 2.65; “SepLLM (n=64)” (orange, solid line) starts at 3.1 and drops to around 2.6; “SepLLM (n=64, H)” (green, solid line) begins at 3.0 and falls to approximately 2.6; and “SepLLM (n=128)” (red, solid line) starts at 2.9 and decreases to about 2.55. All curves exhibit a downward trend, with “SepLLM (n=128)” consistently showing the lowest loss across the iteration range, while “Vanilla” remains the highest.
